SMO_DB_ROLE_PASSWORD_DIR.description: Directory `db_roles.py` (the `migrate` service) reads each module's database password file `db_password_<module>` from (default `/run/secrets`). A path, not a secret.

SMO_MIGRATE_LOCK_ATTEMPTS: Postgres only: how many times `scripts/migrate.py` tries an upgrade or downgrade that hit `SMO_MIGRATE_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS` (default 10), pausing 1 s, doubling to at most 10 s, between tries; then the error ends the Job.
SMO_MIGRATE_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS: Postgres only: milliseconds `scripts/migrate.py` waits for any lock a revision takes (default 5000; `0`: no limit). On a timeout the whole upgrade rolls back, releasing every lock it held, and is tried again (MIGRATE-LOCK-HOLD).
SMO_TIMESCALEDB: Whether `scripts/migrate.py` creates the TimescaleDB extension (D8) before the revisions run: `auto` (default) creates it when the Postgres has it and goes on without it otherwise; `require` stops the migration without it (compose's `migrate` and the chart's bundled Postgres set this); `off` never touches it. The chart takes it from `postgres.external.timescaledb` for an external Postgres.
